Nodes correspond to the movie star actors and two nodes are linked if they co-starred (performed) in the same movie.  The links are un-directed, and can be weighted or not depending on the goals of study.  If the number of times two actors appeared in a movie is needed, links are assigned weights.  The co-stardom network can also be represented by a bipartite graph where nodes are of two types: actors and movies.
